name.en: Periodic electronic structure and k-point sampling

summary.ja: 周期境界、Bloch表現、Brillouin領域の積分をつなぐ。
summary.en: Connect periodic boundaries, Bloch representations and Brillouin-zone integration.

references.label: Monkhorst, H. J.; Pack, J. D. (1976), Special points for Brillouin-zone integrations
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: Isolated or periodic conditions must be selected for each physical system; no numerical boundary-value example is published here yet.

next_deliverable.ja: k点・基底・セルの収束を分離する最小例。
next_deliverable.en: A minimal case separating k-point, basis and cell convergence.

limitations.ja: 日英の導入・代表式・一次文献を公開。専用の実装・数値検証はUnder construction。金属の占有とsmearing幅の依存、有限温度の自由エネルギーと零温度エネルギーを区別します。Γ点だけで十分かは系とセルに依存します。
limitations.en: Introductory bilingual reading, representative equations and primary references are available. No dedicated implementation or numerical verification result is provided yet. Distinguish metallic occupation/smearing dependence, finite-temperature free energy and zero-temperature energy. Whether Γ-only sampling is adequate depends on the system and cell.

metadata_review.level: curated introductory formulation with primary publication and official-documentation entry points; full derivation audit and numerical examples pending

assumptions_ja: 定式化と比較の導入解説であり、実行・検証済みソルバーではありません。
代表式は、各節に別記する場合を除き非相対論・Born–Oppenheimerの電子状態問題を想定します。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・周期を対象系ごとに選ぶ必要があります。この導入には実行済みの境界値計算例はまだありません。

caution.ja: 金属の占有とsmearing幅の依存、有限温度の自由エネルギーと零温度エネルギーを区別します。Γ点だけで十分かは系とセルに依存します。
caution.en: Distinguish metallic occupation/smearing dependence, finite-temperature free energy and zero-temperature energy. Whether Γ-only sampling is adequate depends on the system and cell.
